pr_title: fix: dropIndex now works when providing a tableIndex without name
pr_body:
### Description of change
Fixes #8936 

- Added a  protected generateIndexName on BaseQueryRunners that generates a index name
  - This code was the same on all createIndex function implementation thus made it a generic method
- Added a if statement on all dropIndex methods of QueryRunners to generate a indexName if there is none on the TableIndex
- Added github-issue unit test to verify that this solves the issue

### Pull-Request Checklist

- [ x] Code is up-to-date with the `master` branch
- [ x] `npm run format` to apply prettier formatting
- [ x] `npm run test` passes with this change
- [ x] This pull request links relevant issues as `Fixes #0000`

issue_context.title: DropIndex with a TableIndex without name is not working
issue_context.body:
## Issue Description
When creating a migration you get an up and down method.
In the up method we create a tableIndex by calling the createIndex with a TableIndex without providing a name. When running the migration it will work properly. In the down method we drop a tableIndex by calling the dropIndex with a TableIndex without providing a name. When running the migration revert this will not work properly because the generated name is not generated for the dropIndex method resulting is a error stating name of undefined

### Expected Behavior
I expect that the dropIndex method when providing a TableIndex instance will generate the same index name and thus drop the correct instance without throwing an error.

2. Add a table without the index
3. Add the index after creating the table
4. Run the migration (this will work)
5. Revert the migration (this will not work)

```typescript
import { MigrationInterface, QueryRunner, TableIndex } from 'typeorm';

export class MyCoolMigration1649326707967 implements MigrationInterface {
  private readonly tableName: string = 'cool_table';
  private readonly tableIndex: TableIndex = new TableIndex({
    columnNames: ['cool_column1', 'cool_column2'],
    isUnique: true
  });

  public async up(queryRunner: QueryRunner): Promise<void> {
    await queryRunner.createIndex(this.tableName, this.tableIndex);
  }

  public async down(queryRunner: QueryRunner): Promise<void> {
    await queryRunner.dropIndex(this.tableName, this.tableIndex);
  }
}
```
